hypothesis: An event-sourced account ledger can consolidate repeated Micro-v0.1 plan emissions into account-scoped candidate campaigns and reject mechanically infeasible supplied fills without using retrospective labels or changing candidate, setup, execution, sizing, or selection policy.
required_account_constraint_inputs: maximum total and per-campaign open notional
maximum total and per-campaign open risk

event_contract.ordering: timezone-aware, session-bounded, nondecreasing timestamps plus explicit ledger sequence
event_contract.plan_emissions: already-qualified Micro plan events sharing one candidate activation are one campaign
event_contract.entry_fills: caller-supplied and execution-approved; the ledger validates but never creates or resizes them
event_contract.exit_fills: caller-supplied; accepted exits update FIFO lots, buying power, realized PnL and session guards
event_contract.lock_behavior: terminal for new entries; open positions remain marked flatten-required and supplied exit fills remain admissible
event_contract.halt_behavior: supplied entry and exit fills are rejected while the symbol is halted

simultaneous_opportunity_policy: record the collision; require an externally registered deterministic priority or observed event sequence; never choose by iteration order
prohibited_interpretations: The ledger does not establish a Ross-like sizing policy.
A mechanically feasible fill is not a trade recommendation or evidence that Ross would take it.
Recorded simultaneous opportunities are not ranked or selected.
The standalone ledger is not a portfolio backtest and cannot support a profitability claim.
promotion_gate: Register account-specific numerical policies and a deterministic simultaneous-opportunity priority, integrate the frozen scanner, Micro and execution streams on a new label-blind chronological panel, freeze the runtime artifact, and only then open retrospective actions or outcomes for descriptive evaluation.
